title: Ring confirm stays in memory; explicit save; authored DSL files loaded from disk, not the classpath
description: The ring tool writes every confirmed ring straight into the tracked fixture it loaded (fertility_rings.dsl, skull.dsl), so verification dirties the repo and three agents kept pristine copies to restore; the fixture also lives in src/main/resources while the scene reads target/classes, so the two drift (report items 8 and 16; user ruling: never overwrite a DSL without an explicit save action). Change RingTool and RingDslWriter so confirm and anchor edits only update the in-memory ring set and the rendered rings; a terminal command save [path] (and a matching route) writes the statements, defaulting to the file the scene loaded, and ui-state reports an unsaved-changes flag. Move authored DSL files out of the classpath: a dsl directory at the repository root holds user-authored graphs loaded by path, the ixdar.mesh.dsl property accepts a path there or a fixture name, and in a development checkout fixture names resolve to src/main/resources on disk before the classpath so edits are live without a rebuild; the packaged app keeps the classpath path. Update ModelCatalog listing, list-meshes and the CRAW-28 launch entry accordingly. This ticket touches RingTool and RingDslWriter, so it starts after the craw-rings worktree has landed.
definition-of-done: 1. Confirming a ring in the tool leaves git status clean; the ring renders and ui-state shows unsaved changes. 2. The save command writes the ring statements to the chosen file and reloading that file draws the same rings element-exact. 3. A DSL file under the root dsl directory loads by path from run-scene and F5. 4. Editing a fixture under src/main/resources and rerunning with --skip-build shows the edit. 5. Existing ring tests and the DSL fixtures suite are green; checkstyle green; screenshots under tmp/.
testing-plan: 1. Unit: RingDslWriter save writes only on the explicit call; loader resolution order test. 2. Manual on fertility: confirm two rings, check git status, save, reload, compare fingerprints.
unknowns: Whether fixtures used by tests stay in src/main/resources or also move to the root dsl directory; recommendation: tests keep resources, authored work moves.
